title: News Reporting Writing

mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in place of the comma."
Sometimes three periods are used in place of the comma.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one who knows how to use words effectively."
A good writer is the one who knows how to use words effectively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a typical broadcast tense because it gives a sense of immediacy."
The present tense is a typical broadcast tense because it gives a sense of immediacy.

Midnight tonight is the deadline for private car owners in Lagos to obtain their MOT test certificate, the Lagos City Council reminded car owners yesterday.

Internet Capability The Internet is a new communications technology that is affecting our lives on a scale as significant as the telephone and television.

A story's news value is the value it has to the newspaper printing it.

SEX --Sex is a touchy topic, but it has a strong attraction for readers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art of knowing what to leave out and condense."
